what: Part J's observations in an exported instance that names a model and three workers of its own.

refusals.label: an unknown key
refusals.message: invalid DotLn configuration in <scratch>/part-j-malformed/dotln.config.json: unknown key dotln.config.json#workers.night.claude.temperature; known keys: model, effort

refusals.label: a binding to a model that is not listed
refusals.message: invalid DotLn configuration in <scratch>/part-j-malformed/dotln.config.json: dotln.config.json#workers.night.claude names the model "small", which is not in the model list (opus, fable, sol, astra, sonnet, luna)

refusals.label: a name that would mean two things
refusals.message: invalid DotLn configuration in <scratch>/part-j-malformed/dotln.config.json: the worker "fable" (dotln.config.json#workers.fable) has the name of a model (the kit's model list); a name means one thing

refusals.label: an effort outside its provider's levels
refusals.message: invalid DotLn configuration in <scratch>/part-j-malformed/dotln.config.json: dotln.config.json#workers.night.claude.effort must be one of "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max", the efforts a claude launch takes; found "extreme"

refusals.label: a negative price
refusals.message: invalid DotLn configuration in <scratch>/part-j-malformed/dotln.models.json: dotln.models.json#prices["model-a"].output must be a number that is not negative, in US dollars for a million tokens; found -1
